scope: Canonical SK_WAND DATA transport orchestration, Bernoulli QE/reflect/continuation exclusivity, per-photon flattening, bucket padding and K=12 termination

diagnostic_only_limitations.problem: Reusing production K=12 in the 10x-scattering diagnostic discards a material fraction of surviving detectable light.
diagnostic_only_limitations.evidence: Milano job 39967677, 8192 photons per wavelength at centre/near-wall locations: fraction of K24 expected-QE light deposited after K12 is 25.27% at 300nm, 10.53% at 325nm, 2.56% at 350nm, 0.661% at 375nm, 0.107% at 400nm. K24 still contains a nonzero terminal tail at 300/325nm, so these are lower bounds on the loss relative to fully converged propagation.
diagnostic_only_limitations.reachability: lucid/production/jobs/fitqun/configs/attenscat10x.json selects this physics file. generate_sample_jobs.py:job_command omits --K, so fitqun/__main__.py's sample-run --K default12 and sample_propagate.py:47's K=12 apply to the intended diagnostic workflow.
diagnostic_only_limitations.minimal_fix: Pass a larger K for high-scattering diagnostic runs and verify iteration convergence; the fitqun sample-run CLI already accepts --K, so wire a K field from the diagnostic JSON through generate_sample_jobs.job_command, keeping the default12 for canonical production.
diagnostic_only_limitations.longer_iteration_validation: Milano39969610 reran identical photons/random seed with K96. The K12 deficit relative to K96 is 31.80% at300nm, 11.52% at325nm, 2.63% at350nm, 0.661% at375nm, 0.107% at400nm. Last24 iterations carry no additional detected weight for this finite sample. Artifact scat10x_K96_results.json. K96 is an empirically sufficient setting for this diagnostic sample; other geometries/optical settings need their own convergence check.

executed_checks.meaning: 65,536 actual DATA rays across 8 wavelengths (300--600 nm) and two emission locations. Transport uses actual sampled branches; per_photon output analytically applies QE to expose light versus iteration without K-dependent QE RNG effects.
executed_checks.outcome: No major deposit after step 9, zero light at steps 13--24, no source photon has more than one major deposit. Flat expected QE charge 4348.97754 matches per-sensor charge 4348.97803. Synthetic exact-label kernel verifies all candidate/step rows survive N=37 bucket sizes 16,16,8 with no padding leakage and correct sensor/segment/global-photon alignment.

executed_checks.meaning: 65,536 actual per_segment DATA photons aimed at a real SK_WAND PMT with 0.246 m travel, four wavelength groups, K=12 and full physical absorption/scattering/reflection/QE.
executed_checks.outcome: All 13,017 finite detected rows have unit PE to the first-hit clip tolerance. Each source photon has at most one valid detected row. Direct QE marginal rates agree with QE*exp[-D*(1/L_R+1/L_M+1/L_A)], largest |z|=1.44. Block-count variance ratios 0.875--0.979 are consistent with binomial fluctuations.

code_review_cleared_hypotheses.hypothesis: QE random key collides with first propagation-step random stream
code_review_cleared_hypotheses.resolution: simulator.py:775 splits the initial key and takes branch 1; propagation_step's first split at 606 leaves branch 1 (prop_key) unused, then derives actual photon-update keys only under branch 0. Branches therefore do not collide. Later iterations descend from branch 0.

code_review_cleared_hypotheses.hypothesis: Same photon is counted at multiple PMTs by per-candidate QE draws
code_review_cleared_hypotheses.resolution: Sampled survival terminates at the non-reflecting surface interaction. The hard first_hit_survival weights have one major candidate and sub-threshold residuals. Full per_segment test observed zero multiple finite-time detections.

code_review_cleared_hypotheses.hypothesis: Tiny first_hit_survival residuals become full ghost PE through digitizer minimum-one rounding
code_review_cleared_hypotheses.resolution: first_hit_survival clips p=1 to 1-1e-6, so downstream candidates can retain ~1e-6 weight. make_hits_per_photon's >1e-5 timing mask gives these rows infinite time. digitize_and_decompose:521--529 filters nonfinite times before charge rounding. Six such positive/nonfinite rows were observed and are excluded by that production filter.

code_review_cleared_hypotheses.hypothesis: PMT reflection makes QE happen twice or loses another factor 1-R
code_review_cleared_hypotheses.resolution: Current common_propagation divides QE by 1-R, sampled step deposits with probability 1-R, and make_hits_per_photon applies a single Bernoulli draw at conditional QE. Full path gives measured 400nm direct efficiency 0.22699 versus expected 0.22573.

limitations: Finite sample and code review do not prove all physical laws or all possible inputs correct.
The short-beam expected optical lengths come from evaluate_optical_model; independent validation of its underlying wavelength laws is another audit lane.
K12 convergence statement applies to the tested canonical SK_WAND sample, not arbitrary modified optical parameters.
Accepted endpoint candidate approximation, spherical PMTs, wavelength clamping, timing cuts, fixed group velocity and unpolarised scattering are outside this lane's bug claims.
